classes.name: AVWVCableActor
classes.doc: Wires two nodes together and draws a cable between them. The cable lights up while both ends carry power. Place it in the level, pick the two Actors and it connects them when the game starts.

members.name: Start
members.doc: First end of the cable.

members.name: End
members.doc: Second end of the cable.

members.name: Thickness
members.doc: Cable diameter in centimeters.

members.name: LiveColor
members.doc: Color while power flows through the cable.

members.name: DeadColor
members.doc: Color while the cable is dead.

members.name: CableMaterial
members.doc: Material of the cable. It should expose the vector parameters "Color" and "Emissive". Uses a plain engine material when empty.

members.name: bConnectOnBeginPlay
members.doc: If true the cable creates the electrical connection itself when the game starts. Disable it if you wire the nodes in another way.

members.name: RefreshCable
members.doc: Recomputes the cable geometry from the two end points.

members.name: IsLive
members.doc: True while both ends are connected and energized.

members.name: CableMesh
members.doc: The visible cable, stretched between the two ends.

classes.name: FVWVConnectionTarget
classes.doc: Designer-time reference to another node: an Actor and, if it has several nodes, the name of one of its node components.

members.name: Actor
members.doc: Actor that owns the node to connect to.

members.name: ComponentName
members.doc: Name of the node component on that Actor. Leave empty to use its first node.

classes.name: FVWVFeedbackLook
classes.doc: How lights and materials look in one indicator state.

members.name: Color
members.doc: Color of lights and of the material color/emissive parameters.

members.name: LightIntensity
members.doc: Multiplier of the design-time intensity of affected lights. 0 turns them off.

members.name: Emissive
members.doc: Multiplier of the emissive material parameter. 0 means not glowing.

classes.name: FVWVNetworkInfo
classes.doc: Aggregated information about one isolated network (a set of connected, conducting nodes).

members.name: NetworkId
members.doc: Stable while the network keeps its lowest node. Not a persistent identifier.

members.name: State
members.doc: Overall state of the network.

members.name: NodeCount
members.doc: Number of nodes in the network.

members.name: SupplyCapacityWatts
members.doc: Maximum watts all sources of the network can deliver.

members.name: DemandWatts
members.doc: Watts requested by all consumers.

members.name: DeliveredWatts
members.doc: Watts granted to consumers.

members.name: BatteryDischargeWatts
members.doc: Power currently drawn from batteries.

members.name: BatteryChargeWatts
members.doc: Power currently going into batteries.

members.name: bEnergized
members.doc: True if anything in the network can currently supply power.

classes.name: UVWVBatteryComponent
classes.doc: Stores energy. Charges from surplus power and discharges when the sources of its network cannot cover the demand. Energy is measured in watt-seconds (joules): a 100 W load drains 6000 Ws in one minute.

members.name: CapacityWattSeconds
members.doc: Total capacity in watt-seconds.

members.name: InitialChargeFraction
members.doc: Charge level the battery starts with, as a fraction of its capacity.

members.name: MaxChargeWatts
members.doc: Maximum power drawn from the network while charging.

members.name: MaxDischargeWatts
members.doc: Maximum power the battery can deliver.

members.name: ChargeEfficiency
members.doc: Fraction of the drawn charging power that ends up stored (1 = lossless).

members.name: bChargingAllowed
members.doc: If false the battery never charges.

members.name: bDischargingAllowed
members.doc: If false the battery never discharges (it only stores).

members.name: SetChargingAllowed
members.doc: Allows or forbids charging from surplus power. Server only.

members.name: SetDischargingAllowed
members.doc: Allows or forbids discharging into the network. Server only.

members.name: SetStoredEnergy
members.doc: Sets the stored energy directly (watt-seconds). Server only.

members.name: GetStoredEnergy
members.doc: Stored energy in watt-seconds.

members.name: GetChargeFraction
members.doc: Charge level in [0..1].

members.name: GetBatteryState
members.doc: Current state: idle, charging, discharging, full or empty.

members.name: GetPowerWatts
members.doc: Power flowing right now: positive = discharging into the network, negative = charging.

members.name: GetSecondsUntilEmpty
members.doc: Estimated seconds until empty at the current discharge rate, or -1 if not discharging.

members.name: OnBatteryStateChanged
members.doc: Fires on server and clients when the battery changes between charging, discharging, full and empty.

members.name: StoredWattSeconds
members.doc: Live value in watt-seconds, read only.

members.name: BatteryState
members.doc: Live value, read only.

members.name: PowerWatts
members.doc: Live value in watts (positive = discharging), read only.

classes.name: UVWVBlueprintLibrary
classes.doc: Blueprint helpers for working with the Voltweave without touching components directly.

members.name: GetVoltweaveGrid
members.doc: The grid of the world the context object lives in.

members.name: FindGridNode
members.signature: static UVWVNodeComponent* FindGridNode(AActor* Actor, TSubclassOf<UVWVNodeComponent> NodeClass)
members.doc: Returns the first node of the given type found on an Actor.

members.name: GetGridNodes
members.doc: Returns every grid node on an Actor.

members.name: AddGridNodeToActor
members.signature: static UVWVNodeComponent* AddGridNodeToActor(AActor* Actor, TSubclassOf<UVWVNodeComponent> NodeClass, FName ComponentName = NAME_None)
members.doc: Makes an existing Actor part of the grid by adding a node component to it at runtime. Server only. Returns the new node.

members.name: ConnectActors
members.signature: static bool ConnectActors(AActor* ActorA, AActor* ActorB)
members.doc: Wires the first node of Actor A to the first node of Actor B. Server only.

members.name: DisconnectActors
members.signature: static bool DisconnectActors(AActor* ActorA, AActor* ActorB)
members.doc: Removes the wire between the first nodes of the two Actors. Server only.

members.name: IsActorPowered
members.doc: True if any grid node of the Actor receives power. Works for consumers (powered or brownout) and passive nodes (energized).

members.name: ConsumerStateToText
members.doc: Readable name of a consumer state, for UI.

members.name: NetworkStateToText
members.doc: Display text for a network state, for example for a HUD.

members.name: ProtectionStateToText
members.doc: Display text for a protection device state.

members.name: BatteryStateToText
members.doc: Display text for a battery state.

members.name: FormatWatts
members.doc: Formats watts for UI, e.g. 1500 -> "1.5 kW".

classes.name: UVWVConsumerComponent
classes.doc: Draws power from the grid (light, machine, door, turret...).

members.name: RequestedWatts
members.doc: Power the consumer wants in watts while switched on.

members.name: bSwitchedOn
members.doc: Whether the consumer is switched on and asks for power.

members.name: Priority
members.doc: Lower values are served first when power is short (0 = most important). Only used with the Priority allocation policy.

members.name: bAllowPartialPower
members.doc: If false the consumer only runs with its full demand satisfied (it is shed completely otherwise). If true it can brown out.

members.name: MinOperatingFraction
members.doc: Fraction of the demand below which the consumer gets no power at all (it could not operate anyway).

members.name: SetSwitchedOn
members.doc: Switches the consumer on or off. Server only.

members.name: SetRequestedWatts
members.doc: Changes the requested power. Server only.

members.name: GetPowerState
members.doc: Current state: off, unpowered, underpowered (brownout) or powered.

members.name: GetGrantedWatts
members.doc: Power currently received in watts.

members.name: GetSatisfaction
members.doc: Received / requested power in [0..1]. 1 when powered, 0 when off or unpowered.

members.name: IsPowered
members.doc: True while the consumer receives its full demand.

members.name: HasPower
members.doc: True when the consumer receives any power (Powered or Underpowered).

members.name: OnPowerStateChanged
members.doc: Fires on server and clients when the power state changes.

members.name: OnPowerLevelChanged
members.doc: Fired when the received fraction changes noticeably (at least 1 percent).

members.name: PowerState
members.doc: Live value, read only.

members.name: GrantedWatts
members.doc: Live value in watts, read only.

classes.name: UVWVFeedbackComponent
classes.doc: Makes an Actor visibly react to the state of one of its grid nodes, without any Blueprint scripting. Drives lights (color, intensity) and mesh materials (color and emissive parameters) and works on the server and on clients, because it only reads replicated state.

members.name: Node
members.doc: The node to watch. Leave empty to use the first grid node found on this Actor.

members.name: Targets
members.doc: Lights and meshes to drive. Leave empty to drive every light of the Actor.

members.name: Preset
members.doc: Applies one of the ready-made looks to the four states below.

members.name: OffLook
members.doc: Look while the node is off or unpowered.

members.name: GoodLook
members.doc: Look while the node is working normally.

members.name: WarningLook
members.doc: Look while the node is in a brownout or overheating.

members.name: FaultLook
members.doc: Look while the node is in blackout or tripped.

members.name: bFlickerOnWarning
members.doc: Flicker while the node is in the warning state (a brownout for consumers).

members.name: bScaleBySatisfaction
members.doc: For consumers: additionally scale light intensity and emissive by the received fraction of the demand.

members.name: ColorParameterName
members.doc: Name of the vector material parameter that receives the color.

members.name: EmissiveParameterName
members.doc: Name of the vector material parameter that receives color times emissive strength.

members.name: EmissiveStrength
members.doc: Global multiplier of the emissive strength.

members.name: BlendSpeed
members.doc: How quickly looks blend from one state to the next (higher = faster).

members.name: ApplyPreset
members.doc: Overwrites the four looks with the values of a preset.

members.name: GetLookForState
members.doc: The look for a given state.

members.name: Rebind
members.doc: Re-reads the node and the target list. Call this after adding components at runtime.

classes.name: UVWVGridSubsystem
classes.doc: Owns the electrical simulation of one world. Nodes register themselves on BeginPlay. The subsystem is event driven: it re-solves right away when something changes and only keeps stepping in time while batteries or overheating protection devices need it. Only the server (or a standalone game) solves; clients receive replicated results.

members.name: SolveNow
members.doc: Solves immediately instead of waiting for the next tick. Server only.

members.name: GetNetworks
members.doc: All networks found by the last solve. Server only.

members.name: GetNetworkInfo
members.signature: bool GetNetworkInfo(int32 NetworkId, FVWVNetworkInfo& OutInfo) const
members.doc: Information about the network a node belongs to. Server only.

members.name: GetAllNodes
members.doc: All nodes currently registered in this world.

members.name: GetNodeCount
members.doc: Number of nodes registered in this world.

members.name: GetLastSolveTimeMs
members.doc: Duration of the last solve in milliseconds.

members.name: IsSimulating
members.doc: True if this world instance runs the simulation (server or standalone).

members.name: OnNetworkStateChanged
members.doc: Fired when a network changes its health state, e.g. becomes a blackout.

members.name: OnGridSolved
members.doc: Fired after every solve.

classes.name: UVWVNodeComponent
classes.doc: Base of all electrical components and a plain junction/terminal by itself. Add one of the Voltweave components to any Actor (Blueprint or C++) to make it part of the grid. Nodes are wired together with ConnectTo / InitialConnections. The grid is solved on the server only; the results are replicated, so the owning Actor must have replication enabled in multiplayer games.

members.name: InitialConnections
members.doc: Nodes this node is wired to when the game starts. Links are bidirectional.

members.name: ConnectTo
members.doc: Wires this node to another one. Server only. Returns false if invalid or already connected.

members.name: DisconnectFrom
members.doc: Removes the wire between this node and another one. Server only.

members.name: DisconnectAll
members.doc: Removes every wire of this node. Server only.

members.name: IsConnectedTo
members.doc: True if a wire connects this node directly to Other.

members.name: GetConnections
members.doc: All nodes this node is directly wired to. Available on server and clients.

members.name: SetNodeEnabled
members.doc: A disabled node does not conduct, like a cut wire. Server only.

members.name: IsNodeEnabled
members.doc: False while the node is disabled and acts like a cut wire.

members.name: IsEnergized
members.doc: True if this node belongs to a network that has supply available. Available on server and clients.

members.name: GetNetworkId
members.doc: Identifier of the network this node currently belongs to. Available on server and clients.

members.name: GetNetworkInfo
members.doc: Aggregated information about this node's network. Server only (returns false on clients).

members.name: HasGridAuthority
members.doc: True where the grid is simulated: the server or a standalone game.

members.name: OnEnergizedChanged
members.doc: Fires on server and clients when the node gains or loses power from its network.

members.name: GetDebugLabel
members.doc: Short human readable description of the current state, used by debug drawing and logs.

members.name: GetIndicatorState
members.doc: Simplified state for indicator lights and UI. Available on server and clients.

members.name: bNodeEnabled
members.doc: Whether the node takes part in the network. Replicated.

members.name: bEnergized
members.doc: Live value, read only.

members.name: NetworkId
members.doc: Live value, read only.

classes.name: UVWVProtectionComponent
classes.doc: Circuit breaker or fuse. Sits in series in the network and measures the power flowing through it. When the flow exceeds the rating for long enough (inverse-time curve) it opens and cuts off everything behind it.

members.name: Kind
members.doc: Breakers can be reset, fuses must be replaced.

members.name: RatedWatts
members.doc: Power that may flow through the device continuously. 0 disables the protection.

members.name: TimeToTripAtDoubleLoad
members.display: Time To Trip At Double Load
members.doc: Seconds until the device opens when it carries twice its rating. Smaller overloads take longer, bigger ones are faster.

members.name: InstantTripRatio
members.doc: Flow as a multiple of the rating at or above which the device opens instantly (short circuit). 0 disables.

members.name: CoolingTimeSeconds
members.doc: Seconds the device needs to cool down completely.

members.name: AutoResetDelaySeconds
members.doc: Breakers only: seconds after a trip until the breaker closes by itself. 0 = never.

members.name: State
members.doc: Initial state. Use Open to start with an opened breaker.

members.name: OpenBreaker
members.doc: Manually opens a breaker. Server only. Fuses cannot be opened.

members.name: CloseBreaker
members.doc: Manually closes a breaker or resets a tripped one. Server only. Fails for blown fuses.

members.name: ReplaceFuse
members.doc: Replaces a blown fuse with a new one. Server only.

members.name: ForceTrip
members.doc: Forces the device to trip (breaker) or blow (fuse). Server only.

members.name: GetProtectionState
members.doc: Current state: closed, tripped or blown.

members.name: IsTrippedOrBlown
members.doc: True if the device was opened by an overload.

members.name: GetFlowWatts
members.doc: Power currently flowing through the device.

members.name: GetLoadRatio
members.doc: Flow relative to the rating (1 = at the limit).

members.name: GetHeat
members.doc: Accumulated heat in [0..1]. The device opens at 1.

members.name: OnProtectionStateChanged
members.doc: Fires on server and clients when the device closes, trips or blows.

members.name: OnTripped
members.doc: Fired when the device opened because of an overload.

members.name: FlowWatts
members.doc: Live value in watts, read only.

members.name: Heat
members.doc: Live value in [0..1], read only. The device opens at 1.

classes.name: UVWVSettings
classes.doc: Project-wide settings of the Voltweave plugin (Project Settings > Plugins > Voltweave).

members.name: SolverFrequencyHz
members.doc: How many times per second the network is re-evaluated while something time dependent is happening (battery, overheating protection). Topology and state changes are always solved immediately.

members.name: AllocationPolicy
members.doc: How available power is shared when there is not enough for everyone.

members.name: MaxCascadeIterations
members.doc: Upper bound of re-solves caused by protection devices tripping within one evaluation (cascading trips).

members.name: bDrawDebugByDefault
members.doc: Draw nodes, links and their state in the world while playing (also toggled by the console variable Voltweave.Debug.Draw).

members.name: bLogNetworkEvents
members.doc: Writes network changes (blackouts, trips) to the log.

classes.name: UVWVSourceComponent
classes.doc: Produces power (generator, solar panel, mains connection...).

members.name: MaxOutputWatts
members.doc: Maximum power the source can deliver in watts.

members.name: bRunning
members.doc: Whether the source is running.

members.name: OutputScale
members.doc: Scales the capacity between 0 and 1, for example to model a throttled generator or the sun's angle.

members.name: SetRunning
members.doc: Starts or stops the source. Server only.

members.name: SetMaxOutputWatts
members.doc: Changes the maximum output. Server only.

members.name: SetOutputScale
members.doc: Changes the capacity scale in [0..1]. Server only.

members.name: GetAvailableWatts
members.doc: Capacity the source offers right now (0 if stopped or disabled).

members.name: GetOutputWatts
members.doc: Power the source currently delivers.

members.name: GetLoadFraction
members.doc: Current output relative to the available capacity [0..1].

members.name: OnRunningChanged
members.doc: Fires on server and clients when the source is started or stopped.

members.name: OnOutputChanged
members.doc: Fires on server and clients when the delivered output changes noticeably.

members.name: OutputWatts
members.doc: Live value in watts, read only.

classes.name: UVWVSwitchComponent
classes.doc: A manual switch. Power flows through it only while it is closed.

members.name: bClosed
members.doc: Initial position and current state. A closed switch conducts.

members.name: SetClosed
members.doc: Opens or closes the switch. Server only.

members.name: Toggle
members.doc: Flips the switch. Server only. Returns the new state (true = closed).

members.name: IsClosed
members.doc: True while the switch conducts.

members.name: OnSwitchChanged
members.doc: Fires on server and clients when the switch opens or closes.

enums.name: EVWVAllocationPolicy
enums.doc: How available power is shared between consumers.

values.name: Priority
values.doc: Consumers with a lower Priority value are served first.

values.name: Proportional
values.doc: Every consumer receives the same fraction of its demand.

enums.name: EVWVConsumerState
enums.doc: How a consumer is currently supplied.

values.name: Off
values.doc: The consumer does not request power (switched off or zero demand).

values.name: Unpowered
values.doc: The consumer requests power but receives none.

values.name: Underpowered
values.doc: The consumer receives only part of the requested power (brownout).

values.name: Powered
values.doc: The consumer receives all requested power.

values.name: Custom
values.doc: You configure every state yourself.

values.name: Lamp
values.doc: A lamp: lights up while powered, dims and flickers during a brownout, dark otherwise.

values.name: IndicatorLED
values.doc: A status LED: green = good, amber = warning, red = fault, dark = off.

enums.name: EVWVIndicatorState
enums.doc: Simplified health of any node, meant for indicator lights and UI.

values.name: Off
values.doc: Inactive, switched off or without a function right now.

values.name: Good
values.doc: Working normally.

values.name: Warning
values.doc: Working but stressed, partially supplied or manually opened.

values.name: Fault
values.doc: Failed: no power, tripped, blown or empty.

enums.name: EVWVNetworkState
enums.doc: Health of an isolated electrical network.

values.name: Idle
values.doc: No demand and no supply.

values.name: Healthy
values.doc: All demand is satisfied.

values.name: Deficit
values.doc: Supply exists but demand exceeds it.

values.name: Blackout
values.doc: Consumers request power but nothing can supply it.

values.name: Breaker
values.doc: Trips on overload and can be reset any number of times.

values.name: Fuse
values.doc: Blows on overload and must be replaced.

values.name: Closed
values.doc: Conducting.

values.name: Open
values.doc: Manually opened (breaker only).

values.name: Tripped
values.doc: Opened automatically because of an overload (breaker).

values.name: Blown
values.doc: Destroyed because of an overload (fuse).
